line: A tabletop world of clay, felt and painted wood, filmed in stop-motion with fingerprints left in.
line_cn: 黏土、毛毡和彩绘木头搭成的桌面世界，定格拍摄，指纹留在上面。
lineage: Structure after lemo-opuscar STYLE.md (CC BY 4.0); text written for the H3 pipeline.
essence: Everything is handmade: clay with fingerprints, felt with fibres, painted wood with brush marks.
A single diorama on a table, seen from above at an angle; the edge of the base is allowed in frame.
Stop-motion stepping; things squash, stretch and wobble.
Bold, chalky, matte colours; no gloss.
One world, one take, the seasons or hours turn inside it.
not: Not CGI claymation: real-material imperfections are the point.
Not a brick toy: no studs, no plastic gloss.
Not a miniature photo: the materials are obviously craft.
materials: Modelling clay with fingerprints and tool marks; felt and wool; painted balsa.
A tabletop base with a visible edge; a cardboard sky.
Soft studio light with one warm key; matte surfaces.

rules: Chalky pastels with one or two saturated accents; nothing glossy.
The base is a single colour felt or painted wood.
The season or hour changes the key colour, not the materials.
colour.examplePalette: felt green #7fa86a, clay terracotta #c97b5a, sky card #cfe3ef, accent coral #f0735a, wood #d8b98a

type.titleFont: a soft rounded display face, as if cut from felt
type.placement: titles in the cardboard sky; captions bottom
rules: Words are assembler captions; the model never letters.
Stop-motion at 12 fps; objects wobble slightly when they stop.
One continuous diorama; changes happen in place, not by cutting away.
The camera moves slowly on an arc around the table.

grammar.note: high oblique, the diorama changing inside
into one corner of the set

framing: High oblique with the base edge in wides; eye level for figures.
The accent colour is always in frame.

sound.ambience: a craft room; a window; birds
sound.silence: the diorama holds; one wobble settles; the next season starts alone
sound.voice: soft, amused, or none for ambient loops

nativeMoves.name: Seasons in place
nativeMoves.what: The same diorama turns through seasons without cutting.
nativeMoves.build: continuous chain of 10–15 s shots, static camera, beats name the season's colour change.

nativeMoves.name: Ambient loop
nativeMoves.what: A periodic motion that runs forever.
nativeMoves.build: loop link, FL2VA, repeat on the timeline.

nativeMoves.name: Squash and spring
nativeMoves.what: A clay thing squats and springs back to mark a change.
nativeMoves.build: one beat: 'the big tree squats and springs back; the leaves turn'.

nativeMoves.name: Table-edge reveal
nativeMoves.what: Pull out until the base edge shows.
nativeMoves.build: pull_out, strong amplitude, els, last shot.

pitfalls.fix: animation claymation; 'fingerprints in the clay, felt fibres' in the suffix.
Say 'stop-motion, stepped' in beats; pace steady.

pitfalls.problem: The diorama becomes a full landscape.
pitfalls.fix: Keep 'tabletop with the base edge visible' in wides.

look.genre: stop-motion clay and felt diorama, handmade, ambient and warm
look.palette: chalky matte pastels, one or two saturated accents, felt green base, card sky
look.camera: slow orbits around a tabletop, high oblique holds, push-ins to corners
look.lighting: soft studio light with one warm key, matte surfaces

negative: only the clay and felt figures and their set are in frame, moving on their own
engine.beatSuffix: A handmade clay and felt diorama on a tabletop, stop-motion, fingerprints and fibres visible.

structures: a day from first light to lamps
a town built in three stages
openings: a bare felt base, the first clay tree pressed on
endings: the loop continues as the music fades
